subject: People Prioritization: OKR Headcount Tradeoffs & Req Triage
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: talent-acq@acme-consulting.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: People Prioritization: OKR Headcount Tradeoffs & Req Triage

Team —

Ahead of Friday's leadership check-in I pulled together a short prioritization for the open reqs that intersect next-quarter OKRs. The goal: one clear ask from leadership about which reqs to approve for hire versus which to hold for the freeze window. I attached a matrix with delta impacts (velocity/OKR risk, cost/month, hiring difficulty).

High level recommendation (short):
- Approve: 2 Backend Infra (sustained infra costs + shipping reliability OKR) — hire now (high OKR impact, medium to low hiring difficulty).
- Approve: 1 Product Manager (integrations) — supports upcoming partner launches; medium impact/medium difficulty.
- Hold / Backfill only if attrition: Data Science lateral hires to be paused — we can temporarily redistribute scope; OKR risk low-to-medium.

Specific asks for Friday:
1) Leadership sign-off on the 3 approved reqs (I flagged them green in the matrix).
2) One-off exception approval for infra hires to bypass the hiring freeze guardrails if we commit to an accelerated ramp plan.
3) Direction on budget source: central headcount reserve vs. product P&L.

Notes: hiring timeline estimates are in the sheet (best-case 6–8 weeks for infra, 8–10 for PM). I cc'd Talent-AC to surface any sourcing constraints.

Attachments: people_prioritization_matrix_v2.xlsx, backfill-impact-scenarios.pdf

Thanks — please reply with approvals/concerns inline so I can update the slide for Friday.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
mobile: 415-555-0123

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People Prioritization: OKR Headcount Tradeoffs & Req Triage

+1 to Vanessa's proposal. A few additions from my side:

- The infra hires are time-sensitive because of the latency SLOs we're committing to for Q1. If we miss that hiring window we either accept higher cost (cloud scaling) or delayed product milestones. I'm in favor of exception.
- For the PM role, can we tighten the scope to a 6-month contract-to-hire? That reduces immediate budget pressure.
- We should quantify downstream cost: one delayed infra hire -> estimated $60k/mo in extra cloud spend for Q1. Add that as a single-line in the slide.

I'll be at the 1pm leadership readout and can vouch for the infra exception. Marking my approval for the two infra reqs; PM pending narrower scope.

—Markus
Markus Klein
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — I support approved infra hires and the conditional PM approval (contract-to-hire). Quick notes:

- Hiring Ops flagged that two infra hires in parallel will need dedicated interviewers; we should budget 8 interview hours per hire from Platform engineering. I'll work with Talent-AC to schedule panel availability.
- For the data science pause, let's surface one minimal backfill for a customer-critical project (CSAT regression monitoring). See row 7 in the matrix.

I'm fine with leadership approving the three items if we commit to the ramp milestones and the cloud-cost contingency Markus mentioned.

—Jonas
Director, Platform Engineering

Subject: Re: People Prioritization: OKR Headcount Tradeoffs & Req Triage

Approved with direction.

- Leadership grants exception to proceed with the 2 Backend Infra reqs immediately. Condition: hiring team must provide a 30/60/90 ramp plan and one named interviewer per panel by Monday COB.
- PM role: approve on condition we convert to 6-month contract-to-hire and set a hiring budget cap of $18k/mo for sourcing and offer. Talent-AC, please confirm if that cap is realistic.
- Data Science hires: pause for now. Approve a single short-term backfill for the CSAT regression monitoring project (role to be scoped by Jonas).

I'll update the leadership slide deck with these bullet decisions and the cost contingency note (Markus). Vanessa — please send me the final slide by 10am Friday; I'll include it in the readout.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: people_prioritization_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: backfill-impact-scenarios.pdf (pdf)]
